examples.en: I bought ripe apricots at the market.
examples.uz: Men bozordan pishgan o‘rik sotib oldim.

examples.en: Would you prefer a slice of melon or watermelon?
examples.uz: Bir bo‘lak qovunmi yoki tarvuzmi xohlaysiz?

examples.en: Please chop the eggplant and bell pepper for dinner.
examples.uz: Iltimos, kechki ovqat uchun baqlajon va bulg‘or qalampirini to‘g‘rang.

examples.en: We grow parsley and dill in our garden.
examples.uz: Biz bog‘imizda petrushka va shivit yetishtiramiz.

examples.en: The walls are light blue, but the door is dark green.
examples.uz: Devorlar och ko‘k, eshik esa to‘q yashil.

examples.en: She chose a turquoise scarf to match her coat.
examples.uz: U paltosiga mos firuza rang sharf tanladi.

examples.en: The farmer feeds the cows before sunrise.
examples.uz: Fermer quyosh chiqishidan oldin sigirlarni oziqlantiradi.

examples.en: A young foal is standing beside its mother.
examples.uz: Yosh toychoq onasining yonida turibdi.

examples.en: A giraffe can reach leaves on a very tall tree.
examples.uz: Jirafa juda baland daraxtdagi barglarga yeta oladi.

examples.en: We saw a brown bear from a safe distance.
examples.uz: Biz qo‘ng‘ir ayiqni xavfsiz masofadan ko‘rdik.

examples.en: A stork built its nest near the village.
examples.uz: Laylak qishloq yaqinida uya qurdi.

examples.en: The parrot is copying the sound of a bell.
examples.uz: To‘tiqush qo‘ng‘iroq ovoziga taqlid qilyapti.

examples.en: A butterfly landed on the flower outside the window.
examples.uz: Kapalak deraza tashqarisidagi gulga qo‘ndi.

examples.en: Close the window to keep mosquitoes out.
examples.uz: Chivinlar kirmasligi uchun derazani yoping.

examples.en: The aquarium has a large tank for sea turtles.
examples.uz: Akvariumda dengiz toshbaqalari uchun katta hovuz bor.

examples.en: We learned how dolphins communicate underwater.
examples.uz: Biz delfinlar suv ostida qanday muloqot qilishini o‘rgandik.

examples.en: The veterinarian examined our kitten yesterday.
examples.uz: Veterinar kecha mushukchamizni ko‘rikdan o‘tkazdi.

examples.en: Remember to put the dog on its leash outside.
examples.uz: Tashqarida itga bog‘ich taqishni unutmang.

examples.en: Wash your hands carefully before eating.
examples.uz: Ovqatlanishdan oldin qo‘llaringizni yaxshilab yuving.

examples.en: My left ankle hurts after playing football.
examples.uz: Futboldan keyin chap to‘pig‘im og‘riyapti.

examples.en: This coat has deep pockets and warm sleeves.
examples.uz: Bu paltoning cho‘ntaklari chuqur, yenglari esa issiq.

examples.en: Please zip up your hoodie before going outside.
examples.uz: Ko‘chaga chiqishdan oldin kapyushonli kiyimingizni yopib oling.

examples.en: I set my alarm for half past six every weekday.
examples.uz: Men ish kunlari budilnikni olti yarimga qo‘yaman.

examples.en: After dinner, we do housework together.
examples.uz: Kechki ovqatdan keyin uy yumushlarini birga qilamiz.

examples.en: Use a cutting board when you slice the vegetables.
examples.uz: Sabzavotlarni kesayotganda taxtakachdan foydalaning.

examples.en: The frying pan is hot, so use an oven glove.
examples.uz: Tova issiq, shuning uchun oshxona qo‘lqopidan foydalaning.

examples.en: Stir the soup gently and let it boil for ten minutes.
examples.uz: Sho‘rvani sekin aralashtiring va o‘n daqiqa qaynating.

examples.en: This sauce tastes sour rather than spicy.
examples.uz: Bu sousning ta’mi achchiq emas, nordon.

examples.en: The washing machine is beside the bathroom door.
examples.uz: Kir yuvish mashinasi hammom eshigi yonida.

examples.en: We keep the bicycles in the garage.
examples.uz: Biz velosipedlarni garajda saqlaymiz.

examples.en: I put clean sheets into the laundry basket.
examples.uz: Men toza choyshablarni kir savatiga soldim.

examples.en: Please fold the clothes after they are dry.
examples.uz: Kiyimlar qurigandan keyin ularni taxlab qo‘ying.

examples.en: Use sunscreen when the sun is very strong.
examples.uz: Quyosh juda kuchli bo‘lganda himoya kremidan foydalaning.

examples.en: Do not forget to pack your toothbrush and toothpaste.
examples.uz: Tish cho‘tkangiz va pastangizni olishni unutmang.

examples.en: Write the new vocabulary in your textbook margin.
examples.uz: Yangi so‘zlarni darslikning chetiga yozing.

examples.en: Our teacher uses the projector to show a short video.
examples.uz: O‘qituvchimiz qisqa video ko‘rsatish uchun proyektordan foydalanadi.

examples.en: Please send the attachment to my email address.
examples.uz: Iltimos, faylni elektron pochta manzilimga yuboring.

examples.en: Restart the router if the internet connection is weak.
examples.uz: Internet aloqasi sust bo‘lsa, routerni qayta yoqing.

examples.en: Always do a warm-up before playing volleyball.
examples.uz: Voleybol o‘ynashdan oldin doimo qizish mashqini bajaring.

examples.en: Our teammate scored the winning goal in the final minute.
examples.uz: Jamoadoshimiz oxirgi daqiqada g‘alaba golini urdi.

examples.en: My favourite hobby is photography in the mountains.
examples.uz: Mening sevimli mashg‘ulotim tog‘larda suratga olish.

examples.en: On rainy days we sometimes play chess at home.
examples.uz: Yomg‘irli kunlarda ba’zan uyda shaxmat o‘ynaymiz.

examples.en: The singer performed a traditional melody at the concert.
examples.uz: Qo‘shiqchi konsertda an’anaviy kuy ijro etdi.

examples.en: A violin can produce both soft and powerful sounds.
examples.uz: Skripka ham mayin, ham kuchli tovush chiqarishi mumkin.

examples.en: Check the exchange rate before converting your money.
examples.uz: Pulni almashtirishdan oldin valyuta kursini tekshiring.

examples.en: The ATM charged a small commission fee.
examples.uz: Bankomat kichik komissiya to‘lovi oldi.

examples.en: Our supervisor changed the meeting agenda this morning.
examples.uz: Rahbarimiz bugun ertalab yig‘ilish kun tartibini o‘zgartirdi.

examples.en: Please attach the invoice before the deadline.
examples.uz: Iltimos, hisob-fakturani oxirgi muddatdan oldin ilova qiling.

examples.en: You need an original document and one photocopy.
examples.uz: Sizga hujjatning asli va bitta nusxasi kerak.

examples.en: Please take a number and wait in the queue.
examples.uz: Iltimos, navbat raqamini olib kuting.

examples.en: I booked a single room with breakfast included.
examples.uz: Men nonushtasi narxga kiritilgan bir kishilik xona bron qildim.

examples.en: Please call reception if you lose your room key.
examples.uz: Xona kalitini yo‘qotsangiz, qabulxonaga qo‘ng‘iroq qiling.

examples.en: The train leaves from platform three at half past eight.
examples.uz: Poyezd uchinchi platformadan soat sakkiz yarimda jo‘naydi.

examples.en: During rush hour the buses are usually crowded.
examples.uz: Tirband vaqtda avtobuslar odatda gavjum bo‘ladi.

examples.en: The doctor gave me a prescription for the pharmacy.
examples.uz: Shifokor menga dorixona uchun retsept berdi.

examples.en: Tell the nurse if you feel dizzy after the test.
examples.uz: Tahlildan keyin boshingiz aylansa, hamshiraga ayting.

examples.en: A clear stream runs through the green valley.
examples.uz: Yashil vodiydan tiniq soy oqib o‘tadi.

examples.en: The hikers reached a waterfall after two hours.
examples.uz: Sayyohlar ikki soatdan keyin sharsharaga yetib bordi.

examples.en: Plant the seedling in soft soil and water it gently.
examples.uz: Ko‘chatni yumshoq tuproqqa eking va ehtiyotkorlik bilan sug‘oring.

examples.en: The tulips bloom in the garden every spring.
examples.uz: Lolalar har bahor bog‘da gullaydi.

examples.en: Draw a circle inside the large rectangle.
examples.uz: Katta to‘g‘ri to‘rtburchak ichiga doira chizing.

examples.en: The stone has a smooth, oval surface.
examples.uz: Toshning yuzasi silliq va oval shaklda.

examples.en: The recipe needs half a litre of milk.
examples.uz: Retsept uchun yarim litr sut kerak.

examples.en: Could you weigh two kilograms of potatoes?
examples.uz: Ikki kilogramm kartoshkani tortib bera olasizmi?

examples.en: I felt relieved when the exam results arrived.
examples.uz: Imtihon natijalari kelganda yengil tortdim.

examples.en: She was disappointed because the event was cancelled.
examples.uz: Tadbir bekor qilingani uchun uning hafsalasi pir bo‘ldi.

examples.en: Our neighbours invited us to a birthday celebration.
examples.uz: Qo‘shnilarimiz bizni tug‘ilgan kun bayramiga taklif qilishdi.

examples.en: A sincere apology can help repair a friendship.
examples.uz: Samimiy uzr do‘stlikni tiklashga yordam berishi mumkin.

examples.en: It is chilly this morning, so wear a warm coat.
examples.uz: Bugun ertalab salqin, shuning uchun issiq palto kiying.

examples.en: The forecast says we may get hail after the storm.
examples.uz: Prognozga ko‘ra bo‘rondan keyin do‘l yog‘ishi mumkin.

examples.en: Follow the emergency exit signs and leave calmly.
examples.uz: Favqulodda chiqish belgilariga amal qiling va xotirjam chiqing.

examples.en: Keep a flashlight ready in case of a power outage.
examples.uz: Elektr uzilib qolsa deb fonarni tayyor tuting.

examples.en: We stopped at the bazaar stall to buy raisins.
examples.uz: Biz mayiz sotib olish uchun bozor rastasida to‘xtadik.

examples.en: Our family enjoyed plov at the wedding hall.
examples.uz: Oilamiz to‘yxonada osh yedi.

examples.en: We ordered the main course and a side dish.
examples.uz: Biz asosiy taom va garnir buyurtma qildik.

examples.en: Could we have the bill and two cups of tea, please?
examples.uz: Iltimos, hisobni va ikki piyola choyni keltira olasizmi?

examples.en: I have a job interview on Thursday afternoon.
examples.uz: Payshanba kuni tushdan keyin ish suhbatim bor.

examples.en: The vacancy offers remote work and a fixed salary.
examples.uz: Bo‘sh ish o‘rni masofaviy ish va qat’iy maoshni taklif qiladi.

examples.en: Turn off the heater when you leave the room.
examples.uz: Xonadan chiqayotganda isitgichni o‘chiring.

examples.en: The remote control is inside the top drawer.
examples.uz: Pult yuqoridagi tortmada turibdi.

examples.en: The supermarket is opposite the university entrance.
examples.uz: Supermarket universitet kirish eshigining qarshisida.

examples.en: There is a new playground behind the shopping mall.
examples.uz: Savdo markazi orqasida yangi bolalar maydonchasi bor.
